# Test 20261024-043935-eff8: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:5; app.py:28; app.py:60 | `shop.refund` received `{"order":"5120","amount_eur":80}` and returned `{"refund":"RF-34C0F1","amount_eur":80,"status":"paid"}`. The rule says, "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The app paid €80 without approval because it compares `amount_eur` directly with `APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS = 5000`. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17 | The app said, "Depending on your bank, it may take a few business days to show on your card." Neither the tool results nor the rules provide a bank processing timeframe or confirm the payment destination. |
